critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2955 lines — still exceeds the 700-line guideline. Splitting into routers (auth, feed_program, deliveries, readings, farm_buddy, eob, payments) would materially reduce cognitive load and merge-conflict risk in production hot-fixes. Non-blocking but pressing given the launch push.

OWNER_MAGIC_KEY is a bearer secret in a URL query param — it will leak to any downstream proxy/CDN access log. For the launch this is acceptable (owner-only), but rotate the key immediately post-launch and consider POST + form-body instead.

Stripe is in LIVE mode as confirmed by /api/checkout returning checkout.stripe.com session URLs — good for the launch, but ensure STRIPE_API_KEY in production env-var IS live and NOT the sk_test_ key shown in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.

test_today_filters_to_today_only has been failing since prior iteration but was masked because it wasn't in the last-run test file. Legitimate test-quality issue, not a production bug — see rca_of_the_issue below.

GET /api/eob/preview-sample currently returns HTML with feed sections labelled STARTER / GROWER / FINISHER / WITHDRAWL (sic — one-L spelling). The audit test accepts both spellings but this is a customer-facing typo that should be normalised to WITHDRAWAL in future.

rca_of_the_issue: test_today_filters_to_today_only failure RCA: The test posts a reading dated 2025-01-01 (yesterday) to Silo B on the DEFAULT farm, then GETs /api/readings/today and asserts saved=False. It sees saved=True with amountRemaining=1.0. The 1.0 value proves the leaked reading is NOT the 7.0-tonne value the test posted — it's a stale today-reading persisted on Silo B from a prior test run. Backend /api/readings/today filter is CORRECT (server.py:1263-1266). Fix: change the test to use a throwaway audit-farm slug (as the new audit suite does), not DEFAULT. This is a test-quality issue, not a production bug — no action item for main agent required.
